    1: """S86-TWO-LAYER-OBSTRUCTION-LANDING (S86 W1b T7).
    2: 
    3: Lands the W5-7 PASS (n_joint = 0/5 across the 5-regulator atlas
    4: {zeta, Zubarev, SDW, cutoff_sqrt, anomaly}) into
    5: sessions/permanent-results-registry.md §VII-B as the permanent
    6: "Two-Layer Obstruction Theorem (Lizzi-track)" entry, with the
    7: strengthening clause "every conjunct fails individually for every
    8: regulator" and the (definition -> substitution -> simplification ->
    9: direction) substitution chain.
   10: 
   11: Pure I/O + SHA hashing. CPU-only. No GPU/numpy linalg.
   12: 
   13: Substitution chain (verified at write-time):
   14:     Step 1 (Definition): Joint(r) := AND_i C_i(r); Atlas:= {zeta, Zubarev, SDW, cutoff_sqrt, anomaly}.
   15:     Step 2 (Substitution): W5-7 measured n_joint = 0/5; Lizzi strengthening:
   16:         for every r in Atlas and every conjunct C_i, C_i(r) = FALSE.
   17:     Step 3 (Simplification): if any C_i(r) = FALSE then Joint(r) = FALSE.
   18:         Strengthening: for-all r, for-all i: C_i(r) = FALSE
   19:         => for-all r: Joint(r) = FALSE => n_joint = 0/5 (matches measurement).
   20:     Step 4 (Direction): obstruction is STRONGER than predicted joint failure.
   21:         Each individual conjunct is a wall, not just their conjunction.
   22: """
